app.title: Soulcraft
rotate.title: Turn your phone
rotate.body: Soulcraft plays in landscape. Rotate your device to continue.
nogl.title: 3D graphics unavailable
nogl.body: Your browser or device could not start WebGL, which Soulcraft needs. Try another browser, turn on hardware acceleration, or update your system.
loading.title: Loading
loading.tip1: Tip: hold the break button to mine a block.
loading.tip2: Tip: villagers trade better with friends.
loading.tip3: Tip: soul crystals glow deep underground.
loading.tip4: Tip: build a shelter before your first night.
newworld.title: New World
newworld.name: World name
settings.title: Settings
pause.title: Paused
toast.saveFailed: Saving failed - storage may be full
toast.needLantern: Craft a Void Lantern to open the path
death.title: You fell
death.cause.generic: Your soul drifts back to the world.
death.cause.fall: You fell from a great height.
death.keep: You keep your items. Try again!
inv.title: Inventory
inv.hint: Tap an item, then tap a slot to move it.
trade.title: Trading - {name}
shop.title: Soul Shop
shop.hint: Mine soul crystals and defeat guardians to earn more. No real money.
map.title: Soul Map
map.hint: Defeat each guardian to unlock the next realm.
boss.voidDragon.intro: Guardian of the empty sky. Shatter its crystals, then strike when it dives.
boss.shellKing.intro: Dodge the dark shells. Hit the glowing ones back at him!
boss.whirlwindKing.intro: Only wind can hurt wind. Gather Wind Charges and throw them.
boss.emberWarden.intro: Emberite and gold blades bite deepest. Beware the fire spirits.
boss.soulStorm.intro: Every lost soul, bound in one storm. End it.
victory.title: The storm is stilled
victory.body: Every guardian has fallen. The souls are free, and the world is yours to build.
tut.move: Drag the left side to move.
tut.moveDesktop: Use W A S D to move and the mouse to look.
tut.look: Drag the right side to look around.
tut.break: Aim at a block and hold the pickaxe button to break it.
tut.breakDesktop: Hold the left mouse button to break a block.
tut.place: Pick a block in the hotbar, then tap the block button to place it.
tut.placeDesktop: Right-click to place the selected block.
tut.craft: Open the inventory and use the recipe book to craft planks.
tut.night: Night brings enemies. Build a shelter or craft a sword!
tut.village: Villagers trade goods. Tap a villager to trade.
tut.map: Craft a Void Lantern to open the Soul Map and face the first guardian.
desc.void_lantern: Opens the Soul Map. Lights the way to the Void.
desc.spear: Throw it, then pick it up again.
desc.gold_sword: Extra damage against the Ember Warden.
desc.emberite_sword: Huge damage against the Ember Warden.
dev.title: Developer
error.save: Could not open storage. Progress will not be saved in this browser.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Reload to try again.
quest.name: Treasure Quest
quest.intro: An old legend speaks of a hidden vault. Find the treasure map in the ruins, then cross twelve trials - traps, monsters, puzzles and jumps - and defeat the Hoard Golem that guards the gold.
quest.rewards: Reward: the legendary Treasure Hunter skin, the Starfall Blade and 250 soul crystals.
quest.obj.0: Head down the path to the ruins and find the treasure map.
quest.obj.1: Search the maze for the treasure map.
quest.obj.2: Jump from stone to stone - don't fall!
quest.obj.3: Run the hall. Traps glow red just before they fire.
quest.obj.4: Defeat every monster in the den
quest.obj.5: Each lever flips its lamp and its neighbours. Light all four lamps
quest.obj.6: Keep moving - the bridge crumbles under your feet.
quest.obj.7: Find the three golden keys hidden in the grove
quest.obj.8: Watch the tiles light up, then step on them in the same order.
quest.obj.9: Find the way through the dark maze. Monsters lurk inside.
quest.obj.10: Step on the green pads to fly across the gaps.
quest.obj.11: Build a bridge of planks across the gap.
quest.obj.gateOpen: Done! The gate ahead is open.
quest.obj.done: Quest complete - the treasure is yours!
quest.fell: You fell - back to the checkpoint
quest.burned: The magma burned you - back to the checkpoint
quest.denClosed: The gate slams shut behind you!
quest.yourTurn: Your turn: step on the tiles in order
quest.planks: You picked up planks for the bridge
quest.vaultOpen: The way to the vault is open!
quest.completeBody: The vault is yours. Your new skin and blade are waiting in every Soulcraft world.
tut.questBoss: The Hoard Golem charges after a wind-up. Step aside - when it crashes, hit its glowing core!
tut.questBoss2: The Frost Warden leaps at you - watch for the ring and step out of it. When it lands frozen, strike hard: its hits count double!
boss.hoardGolem.intro: Guardian of the vault. Dodge its charge, then strike the exposed core.
boss.hint.core: Its core is exposed - strike now!
desc.treasure_map: Shows the route to the treasure.
desc.starfall_blade: A legendary blade from the Treasure Quest.
acct.note: Accounts are created by the game's admin. You can also play without one - saves then stay on this device.
acct.err.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
acct.err.admin_use_panel: The admin signs in at soulcraft.8nomads.com/admin.
acct.err.generic: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
acct.err.weak_password: The new password must be at least 6 characters.
acct.err.email_taken: That email is already used by another player.
acct.err.phone_taken: That phone number is already used by another player.
acct.err.bad_email: That email address does not look right.
acct.err.bad_phone: The phone number should be 6-16 digits, optionally starting with +.
acct.err.bad_name: Please enter a name (up to 40 characters).
acct.err.need_login: Keep an email or a phone number to sign in with.
acct.err.bad_avatar: That picture could not be used. Try a PNG or JPEG.
acct.name: Name
acct.cloud: Your worlds, quest progress, crystals and skins are saved to your account and follow you to any device.
acct.signedOut: Signed out - playing as a guest
worlds.title: Your worlds
worlds.deleteQ: "{name}" will be deleted on every device. This can't be undone.
worlds.full: You already have {n} worlds. Delete one to make room.
mode.survivalHint: Gather, craft and survive the nights. Earn soul crystals.
mode.creativeHint: Fly, build with every block, no damage or hunger. No soul crystals here.
toast.flyOn: Flying: jump rises, Shift or the down button descends
death.cause.cactus: A cactus got the better of you.
pet.fox.desc: Quick and brave: bites monsters near you.
pet.owl.desc: Flies above you and shoots ice shards.
pet.golem.desc: Slow and tough: heavy punches knock monsters away.
pet.rest: {name} is worn out and rests for {s} s.
daily.title: Daily tasks
daily.hint: New tasks every day. Finish all three for a bonus of {n} crystals. Survival worlds only.
daily.done: Daily task done: {task}! Claim it in the pause menu.
event.bloom.desc: Petals drift on the wind, and daily tasks pay double.
event.harvest.desc: Embers rise at dusk, and monsters drop soul crystals three times as often.
event.frost.desc: Snow falls everywhere, and the first villager you talk to each day has a gift.
acct.forgotHelp: Enter the email of your account and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
acct.linkSent: If this email belongs to an account, a link is on its way. Check your inbox (and spam).
acct.resetDone: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
acct.err.bad_token: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
acct.err.email_not_configured: Password reset by email is not ready yet. Ask the admin to reset your password.
acct.err.email_failed: The email could not be sent. Try again later.
quest.obj.toCh2: Chapter 2 awaits: go through the door at the back of the vault.
quest.obj.14: Slide across the ice and jump the gaps.
quest.obj.15: Cross while the violet bridges shine - they fade away!
quest.obj.16: Ride the updrafts over the walls.
quest.obj.17: Light all four plates at the same time.
quest.obj.18: Run past the jets between their blasts.
quest.obj.19: Collect every frost orb before time runs out.
quest.obj.20: Defeat every monster in the den.
quest.obj.done2: Chapter 2 complete - the Frozen Spire is yours!
quest.raceGo: Go! {s} seconds to collect every orb.
quest.raceLost: Time's up! The orbs are back in place.
quest.completeBody2: Your Frost Monarch skin and the Frostbrand are waiting in every Soulcraft world.
boss.frostWarden.intro: Knight of the Frozen Spire. Dodge its leap and strike while its feet are frozen.
boss.hint.leap: It is about to leap - get out of the ring!
boss.hint.frozen: Its feet are frozen - strike now!
desc.frostbrand: A blade of living ice from the Frozen Spire.
desc.frost_orb: Collect them all before the time runs out.
mp.title: Play with friends
mp.shareHint: Give your friends this code. They choose Join friend on the title screen (signed in) and type it. Up to 4 players.
mp.guestHint: You are in a friend's world. Your things stay there for next time.
mp.openHelp: Open this world to up to 3 friends with accounts. The world keeps going while you are in a menu. Guardians and other realms wait until you play alone again.
mp.joinHelp: Ask your friend for the 6-character room code from their pause menu.
mp.signInFirst: Sign in to play with friends. Accounts are made by the admin.
mp.roomClosed: The room was closed. You keep playing alone.
mp.lost: The connection to the room was lost.
mp.noTravel: Other realms are closed while friends play here
mp.noBoss: Guardians only fight you when you play alone
mp.err.noRoom: No open room with this code. Check it with your friend.
mp.err.kicked: The host removed you from the world.
mp.err.unavailable: Playing with friends is not available yet. Try again later.
mp.err.badCode: The code has 6 letters and digits.
mp.err.overworld: Go back to the overworld first.
mp.err.network: Could not connect. Check the internet and try again.
